production.note: US model years from 2024, still on sale (Ford's current US site lists the 2026 Mustang GT Fastback, GT Premium Fastback and GT Premium Convertible, source ford-us-mustang-specs-2026). MotorWeek, December 15, 2022: "the 2024 Mustang GT will conjure up to 486 horsepower from its fourth-generation 5.0-liter Coyote engine".

body.note: Ford calls the coupe the Fastback. Ford's weight table has "Fastback (lbs)" and "Convertible (lbs)" columns for the GT; The Drive's 2024 first drive also covers coupe and convertible (source thedrive-mustang-gt-2024).

displacementL.note: 5,038 cc. Ford's current specifications: "307 cu.in."; Ford's preliminary technical specifications for the 2024 Mustang: "307 cu. in. (5,038 cc)" (source ford-mustang-2024-prelim-techspecs).

aspiration.note: Ti-VCT V8 with no forced induction listed; the supercharged 5.2L engine is the Dark Horse SC's.

drivetrain.note: The Drive's specification box: "5.0-liter V8 | 6-speed manual or 10-speed automatic | rear-wheel drive".

transmission.note: "Standard 6-speed manual with rev matching" and "Available 10-speed automatic" (torque-converter SelectShift). Same two choices from 2024: The Drive, "6-speed manual or 10-speed automatic" (source thedrive-mustang-gt-2024).

powerHp.note: Standard exhaust. Quote, Ford US specifications (2026 model): "480 @ 7,150rpm (93-octane fuel)"; with the optional active exhaust "486 @ 7,250 rpm (active exhaust, 93-octane fuel)". The same ratings applied from launch: MotorWeek, December 15, 2022, on the 2024 car: "Any V8 not rocking said exhaust will instead put down 480 ponies and 415 lb-ft" and up to 486 hp with it (source motorweek-mustang-2024-power).

weightLb.note: GT Fastback with the 6-speed manual, 2026 model. Quote (Ford's 2026 Mustang Technical Specifications, row 'Curb Weight (lbs.)'): GT Fastback manual 3,731, automatic 3,766; GT Convertible manual 3,930, automatic 3,952. Ford's consumer site gives the same figures under the heading "Estimated Base Curb Weights" (ford-us-mustang-specs-2026). Ford's preliminary specifications for the 2024 Mustang (Sept. 14, 2022) gave "Est. curb weight, fastback manual 3,730 lbs." (ford-mustang-2024-prelim-techspecs); no final Ford figure for 2024 or 2025 could be opened, so the reference year is 2026.

discrepancies.reason: Model year and source: 3,731 lb is Ford's 2026 technical-specification curb weight for the GT Fastback manual; 3,730 lb is Ford's preliminary September 2022 figure for the 2024 car; 3,827 lb is the curb weight in The Drive's specification box for the 2024 GT ("Curb weight: 3,827 pounds"), which does not say which trim or transmission it describes (the same box lists the active-exhaust 486 hp and a price range "$44,090 ($50,310)", so it may describe an optioned or Premium car).
discrepancies.resolution: Used Ford's 3,731 lb, a manufacturer figure for the stated configuration, which agrees with Ford's 2024 preliminary figure to within 1 lb.
